fix_hints.HOST_NOT_IN_REGISTRY: Lead came from a host that is not an approved employer domain. Resolve to the employer's own page; never store the aggregator URL.
fix_hints.BLOCKED_HOST: Replace with the employer's own posting/careers URL from the registry (job-board links may only be used for discovery).
fix_hints.GENERIC_LANDING_PAGE: Replace the portal URL with the specific posting URL (job title must appear on the page).
fix_hints.CONTENT_MISMATCH: Replace with the page that carries this exact posting, or add the correct domain/ATS host to the registry.
fix_hints.SOFT_404: Page says "404 / not found" though HTTP=200 - find the current posting URL.
fix_hints.NEEDS_MANUAL_CHECK: Manual review: TLS/403/DNS-filtered host. Open in a browser inside India, capture the true posting URL, then re-run verify_link.
fix_hints.HTTP_404: Dead link - find the current posting URL or drop the record.
fix_hints.MissingSchema: Fetch broke on a relative redirect - retry/replace URL.
fix_hints.EMPLOYER_NOT_IN_REGISTRY: Add the employer (with a verified own domain) to public/employers.json, or drop the lead.
fix_hints.FIELD_NOT_IN_SOURCE: The LLM claimed a title/deadline/compensation/qualification/skill that is not on the fetched page. Re-fetch the page and restructure only what it says.
fix_hints.PAGE_TEXT_UNAVAILABLE: The verified page returned no readable text - re-fetch or replace the URL.
fix_hints.POSITION_CLOSED: The page says applications are closed - archive or replace the record.
fix_hints.TIMEOUT: Source timed out - retry; quarantine persists after 3 nightly failures.
fix_hints.UNREACHABLE_FROM_RUNNER: Runner could not reach the host - retry from another network.
fix_hints.SSL_ERROR: TLS certificate problem - verify the official host; do not bypass verification.
fix_hints.REDIRECT_LOOP: Redirect loop - replace with the final canonical posting URL.
